clientDesk.headline: SkillEdge AI is showing one best idea per ticker after dedupe.

rules: One primary idea per symbol is shown to clients.
Alternatives remain available for debug/calibration only.
Telegram remains strict: ACTIVE + PASSED + premium + telegramEligible.
Strategy mix is informational; it does not override setup-specific risk gates.

policy.meaning: Telegram/Elite is intentionally stricter than Cockpit Active. Zero Telegram-ready ideas can be correct.

policy.goal: Select only truly qualified best ideas for paper-test/forward-test. If none pass strict rules, selectedIdeas stays empty.
policy.minimumDeskRule: strictEligible = actionable + real qualityGuard + deskPassed + score>=78 + RR>=2R + execution confirmation + tier is NEAR_ELITE/BEST/ELITE

interpretation.selectedIdeas: Only strict-qualified desk ideas. Empty is valid and means no high-quality paper-test idea right now.
interpretation.monitorOnly: Active ideas that may still be valid, but are lower priority than selectedIdeas.
interpretation.waitingArmed: Ideas that still need confirmation before becoming active.

cockpitSummary.copy: No engine weights were changed. This preview exists for Cockpit/Reports visibility before any future apply gate.

interpretation.nextStep: S7.5 UI surface for this preview in Cockpit/Reports, then explicit apply gate after 3-5 replay days.
notes: Rows with OBSERVE/INSUFFICIENT_* are useful warnings, not engine mutations.
Do not enable apply until dateCount>=3, replayClosed>=10 and forwardClosed>=10 in hybrid mode.
